description: This file is a CMake script defining the 'compile_aidl' function used in build automation to generate source files from AIDL files with various configuration options. It includes documentation, parameter parsing, and execution logic for invoking the aidl compiler during the build process.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: This function generates source files from provided AIDL files during build time, allowing customization of the aidl compiler path, flags, language, include directories, and output target directory.
